name: team_wf_runs_pool_usage_totals_insert
sql: CREATE TRIGGER team_wf_runs_pool_usage_totals_insert AFTER INSERT ON team_wf_runs_pool_usage BEGIN UPDATE team_wf_runs_pool_usage_totals SET input = input + (NEW.input), input_err = input_err + CASE WHEN abs(input) > abs((NEW.input)) THEN (input - (input + (NEW.input))) + (NEW.input) ELSE ((NEW.input) - (input + (NEW.input))) + input END, output = output + (NEW.output), output_err = output_err + CASE WHEN abs(output) > abs((NEW.output)) THEN (output - (output + (NEW.output))) + (NEW.output) ELSE ((NEW.output) - (output + (NEW.output))) + output END, cacheread = cacheread + (NEW.cacheread), cacheread_err = cacheread_err + CASE WHEN abs(cacheread) > abs((NEW.cacheread)) THEN (cacheread - (cacheread + (NEW.cacheread))) + (NEW.cacheread) ELSE ((NEW.cacheread) - (cacheread + (NEW.cacheread))) + cacheread END, cachewrite = cachewrite + (NEW.cachewrite), cachewrite_err = cachewrite_err + CASE WHEN abs(cachewrite) > abs((NEW.cachewrite)) THEN (cachewrite - (cachewrite + (NEW.cachewrite))) + (NEW.cachewrite) ELSE ((NEW.cachewrite) - (cachewrite + (NEW.cachewrite))) + cachewrite END, cost = cost + (NEW.cost), cost_err = cost_err + CASE WHEN abs(cost) > abs((NEW.cost)) THEN (cost - (cost + (NEW.cost))) + (NEW.cost) ELSE ((NEW.cost) - (cost + (NEW.cost))) + cost END WHERE root = (SELECT root FROM team_wf_runs_work WHERE id = NEW.work) END

name: wf_runs_pool_usage_totals_insert
sql: CREATE TRIGGER wf_runs_pool_usage_totals_insert AFTER INSERT ON wf_runs_pool_usage BEGIN UPDATE wf_runs_pool_usage_totals SET input = input + (NEW.input), input_err = input_err + CASE WHEN abs(input) > abs((NEW.input)) THEN (input - (input + (NEW.input))) + (NEW.input) ELSE ((NEW.input) - (input + (NEW.input))) + input END, output = output + (NEW.output), output_err = output_err + CASE WHEN abs(output) > abs((NEW.output)) THEN (output - (output + (NEW.output))) + (NEW.output) ELSE ((NEW.output) - (output + (NEW.output))) + output END, cacheread = cacheread + (NEW.cacheread), cacheread_err = cacheread_err + CASE WHEN abs(cacheread) > abs((NEW.cacheread)) THEN (cacheread - (cacheread + (NEW.cacheread))) + (NEW.cacheread) ELSE ((NEW.cacheread) - (cacheread + (NEW.cacheread))) + cacheread END, cachewrite = cachewrite + (NEW.cachewrite), cachewrite_err = cachewrite_err + CASE WHEN abs(cachewrite) > abs((NEW.cachewrite)) THEN (cachewrite - (cachewrite + (NEW.cachewrite))) + (NEW.cachewrite) ELSE ((NEW.cachewrite) - (cachewrite + (NEW.cachewrite))) + cachewrite END, cost = cost + (NEW.cost), cost_err = cost_err + CASE WHEN abs(cost) > abs((NEW.cost)) THEN (cost - (cost + (NEW.cost))) + (NEW.cost) ELSE ((NEW.cost) - (cost + (NEW.cost))) + cost END WHERE root = (SELECT root FROM wf_runs_work WHERE id = NEW.work) END

name: wf_runs_pool_usage_totals_update
sql: CREATE TRIGGER wf_runs_pool_usage_totals_update AFTER UPDATE ON wf_runs_pool_usage WHEN OLD.input IS NOT NEW.input OR OLD.output IS NOT NEW.output OR OLD.cacheread IS NOT NEW.cacheread OR OLD.cachewrite IS NOT NEW.cachewrite OR OLD.cost IS NOT NEW.cost OR OLD.work IS NOT NEW.work BEGIN UPDATE wf_runs_pool_usage_totals SET input = input + (-OLD.input), input_err = input_err + CASE WHEN abs(input) > abs((-OLD.input)) THEN (input - (input + (-OLD.input))) + (-OLD.input) ELSE ((-OLD.input) - (input + (-OLD.input))) + input END, output = output + (-OLD.output), output_err = output_err + CASE WHEN abs(output) > abs((-OLD.output)) THEN (output - (output + (-OLD.output))) + (-OLD.output) ELSE ((-OLD.output) - (output + (-OLD.output))) + output END, cacheread = cacheread + (-OLD.cacheread), cacheread_err = cacheread_err + CASE WHEN abs(cacheread) > abs((-OLD.cacheread)) THEN (cacheread - (cacheread + (-OLD.cacheread))) + (-OLD.cacheread) ELSE ((-OLD.cacheread) - (cacheread + (-OLD.cacheread))) + cacheread END, cachewrite = cachewrite + (-OLD.cachewrite), cachewrite_err = cachewrite_err + CASE WHEN abs(cachewrite) > abs((-OLD.cachewrite)) THEN (cachewrite - (cachewrite + (-OLD.cachewrite))) + (-OLD.cachewrite) ELSE ((-OLD.cachewrite) - (cachewrite + (-OLD.cachewrite))) + cachewrite END, cost = cost + (-OLD.cost), cost_err = cost_err + CASE WHEN abs(cost) > abs((-OLD.cost)) THEN (cost - (cost + (-OLD.cost))) + (-OLD.cost) ELSE ((-OLD.cost) - (cost + (-OLD.cost))) + cost END WHERE root = (SELECT root FROM wf_runs_work WHERE id = OLD.work);
